additions.reason: פרוטה↔קול התור are both aspects of the hidden/latent miracle (נסים), the same domain as Package 1. The teaching in section ה identifies the mill-wheel's lips (=תור) as standing between two depths (תהומות=נסים). The 2-node component shares NATURE with the נסים cluster in Package 1.
וקם is a textual alias for עמידה (standing), which is already in Package 1 as a bechina of תפלה. The 2-node component {וקם, עמידה} collapses fully into Package 1.
יעקב ובניו is directly equated with תפלה (Package 1 dominant node) via an explicit bechina edge. שנים עשר שערי תפלה is a structural sub-aspect of תפלה. Both merge into the prayer cluster.

concepts_in_source_text_not_in_dataset.source_text: כֵּן יֵשׁ בְּנֵי־אָדָם, שֶׁדִּבּוּרָם הוּא חַלּוֹן... וְיֵשׁ, שֶׁאֲמִירָתָם נַעֲשֶׂה אֶבֶן טוֹב
concepts_in_source_text_not_in_dataset.bechina_language: דיבור הוא חלון / דיבור הוא אבן טוב — explicit bechina identification
concepts_in_source_text_not_in_dataset.note: Two bechina pairs are implicit here: (1) דיבור↔חלון for those without inner light, (2) דיבור↔אבן טוב for those whose speech illuminates from within (= truth speakers). These pairs are missing from the dataset for Torah #9. They would form a neutral-to-good cluster around the concept of truth-speech.

analysis_notes.summary: The dataset for Torah #9 contains 25 bechina edges covering the core symbolic identifications. However, at least 8 explicit bechina statements from the source text are not represented as bechina edges in the dataset. Most significant missing entries: (1) evil mirror cluster — חשך↔קליפות, שקר as anti-אמת; (2) the דיבור cluster — חלון/אבן טוב as speech types; (3) עדות↔תפלה; (4) כנען↔אמונה. These gaps affect primarily the evil/darkness dimension (the opponent of prayer) and the speech/truth dimension (the mechanism of prayer).
